paper_title: A Model-Independent Radio Telescope Dark Matter Search in the L and S Bands
notes: Model-independent radio (GBT Breakthrough Listen) search for dark-matter decay/annihilation to a quasimonochromatic radio line over 1020-2700 MHz (L and S bands). The paper's headline results (Fig. 8, 9) are limits on the dark-matter DECAY RATE lambda [s^-1] (~1e-32 s^-1) and ANNIHILATION cross-section <sigma v> [cm^3 s^-1] (~1e-30 cm^3 s^-1) as functions of line frequency / DM mass. These are deliberately model-independent and are NOT expressed as, nor converted to, any particle-physics coupling. The two-photon final state is treated only 'for simplicity' and the paper never derives a g_agamma bound (it explicitly notes these would be far weaker than stellar bounds). No coupling in the AxionLimitBench canonical table (g_agamma, g_ae, etc.) is bounded, so is_new_limit=false. The measurement is a real exclusion, not a projection, but it lies outside the tracked coupling planes (a decay-rate / cross-section limit, not a coupling).
